summary: Picks up files from an SFTP server on a schedule, signing in with a password or a private key, and leaving files still being written for the next run.

properties.name: Port
properties.description: Server port. If empty, 22 is used.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: Account password, or the private key's passphrase when a private key is set.

properties.name: PrivateKey
properties.description: Private key to sign in with instead of a password, in PEM or OpenSSH format. A PEM key pasted onto one line is re-wrapped.

properties.name: HostKeyFingerprint
properties.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server's host key, as 'ssh-keygen -lf' prints it (SHA256:...). When set, a server presenting any other key is refused before credentials are sent.

properties.name: TargetPath
properties.description: Remote directory to read files from.

properties.name: BatchSize
properties.description: Maximum number of files to fetch per polling batch.

properties.name: ResponseEncoding
properties.description: Encoding used to decode file contents: utf8, or base64 for binary files.

properties.name: DeleteMovesFileTo
properties.description: Folder to move a file to after it's received. If empty, the file is deleted instead.

properties.name: CheckFileExistence
properties.description: Whether to verify the file still exists before attempting to delete or move it after receiving.

properties.name: MinimumFileAgeSeconds
properties.description: Seconds a file must have gone unchanged before it is taken, so one still being uploaded is left for the next run. 0 takes every file listed.
